items.title: Help pick my tattoo
items.text:
Help pick my tattoo
I want a tattoo that shows my love of pro wrestling but not blatantly obvious to wrestling. 

I remember the first time I ever saw it, I was a little boy and the undertaker had put someone in a body bag and leg dropped him (some jobber). I was at my grandparents and the show was Main Event. I was hooked. I looked all over the TV guide printed in the local paper for what this show could have been. I had no reference of what to call this show (I was probably 6 years old). 

30 years later, wrestlemania attendances, multiple live shows, indies, comedy shows, etc all pertaining to wrestling I still love it.  It was there when my dad would hit me, I believed the taker would get him. It was there through my parents divorce, it was there to remind me to take my vitamins and say my prayers, it was there to teach me that underdogs win sometimes.   

So. My favorite wrestler is the Macho man, favorite belt is the winged eagle belt, and please ask if you have some idea. 

Team, upvote this and help a fan out.
